column1: computational-engineer-munich-48946,Proxima Fusion GmbH,Computational Engineer,Munich,False,1795869612,"WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSIONYou will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.YOUR IMPACTWe are a special projects team within Proxima’s engineering organisation, using software and computation to fundamentally change how complex machines are designed and built. We take on problems where a small team can deliver a step change in capability, with the goal of getting a stellarator connected to the grid as fast as possible.As a Computational Engineer, you will bring together mechanical engineering experience and strong software development skills. You will work at the intersection of AI and computational engineering, developing approaches to problems that established tools cannot currently solve.You will build things yourself: formulate problems, develop algorithms, write software, and test it against real engineering needs. Your experience with hardware will help you see what really moves the needle.WHAT YOU WILL DOMake new engineering approaches possible. Build CAD-as-code representations, geometry algorithms, and physical models for problems that established tools cannot handle.Enable rapid iteration. Build computational methods to propagate and assess hardware design changes at the speed of software development.Develop agent-driven engineering workflows. Build harnesses and APIs that allow AI to contribute to our mechanical design in radically new ways.Make engineering tools work together. column3: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.&lt

This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged
column4: it’s finished when the system flies.&lt

column3: You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench.&lt

No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side.&lt
Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling.&lt
Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end.&lt
Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it.&lt
Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations.&lt
Work on site with partners and customers to run flight tests, trials and demonstrations, solving problems directly in the field.&lt
Deploy software releases to customer systems, including flashing, configuration and calibration.&lt
Report field learnings back to core engineering in a form they can act on, and help shape the product roadmap with real customer input.&lt
Document what you build so that future teams can repeat it.&lt
Degree in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Robotics or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience&lt
Solid experience developing software in modern C++, plus Python for tooling, automation and data analysis&lt
Strong Linux skills, including the command line, logs, Docker and networking (IP, TCP/UDP)&lt
Experience getting software running on embedded or physical systems, including comfort with UART, CAN, I2C and SPI, wiring, and using a multimeter on the bench&lt
A structured approach to debugging and the ability to stay methodical under time pressure&lt
Clear communication in English with customers, operators and engineers alike&lt
Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink or QGroundControl&lt
Experience with video pipelines, computer vision, or radio and datalink systems&lt
Integration or field engineering experience in automotive, robotics or aerospace&lt
Experience working with defense or government customers&lt

column1: senior-avionics-system-engineer-munich-329071,The Exploration Company,Senior Avionics System Engineer,"Munich, Germany",False,1795826413,"Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.About the RoleThe Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will bring a solid working expertise in electrical power systems, data handling and communications, and you will shape designs that are ready to be challenged, tested and flown.You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project.Key ResponsibilitiesOwn work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost.Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements, flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project.Develop system architectures and conceptual designs, perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces).Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans, and drive them through to completion with the teams involved.Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support.What we would love to see from youIn this role, ideally, you will have the following:Proven hands-on experience in designing electrical systems for spacecraft or other aerospace platforms, with a clear record of delivering them.A broad understanding of the full functional chain of space-based avionics, communications and power systems, and how the pieces interact.Able to work effectively with neighboring subsystems (thermal, GNC, propulsion, flight software, operations), understanding their interfaces and constraints well enough to resolve cross-disciplinary trade-offs and keep interface control documents aligned.Strong systems engineering skills: defining requirements and their flow-down, managing technical baselines, and producing architectures and trade-offs.Experience with budgets and performance analysis (power, mass, data, thermal) to support design decisions.Hands-on experience with development, assembly, integration and testing of electrical units for space applications.Strong written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to engineers, managers and partners.A degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Aerospace Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in the relevant domain.As a guideline, candidates typically bring 5+ years of relevant experience in aerospace system design. We value demonstrated capability over the number of years, so we welcome applications from candidates with a strong track record who may have followed a non-linear path.Skills and BehavioursAnalytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to structure complex problems and reach sound decisions.Organised and pragmatic, able to set priorities across several work packages.Positive and flexible, with a can-do attitude to get the job done.Collaborative, communicating at all levels of the business and working across disciplines.Feedback ready, willing to give proactive and mindful feedback across all levels of the company.Highly motivated, to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven and demanding start-up environment.Why you should join us!What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.  The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc. avionics-system-engineer-navigation-sensors-munich-321895,The Exploration Company,Avionics System Engineer - Navigation Sensors,"Munich, Germany",False,1795826413,"Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. As a Senior Navigation Sensors engineer, you will support the integration and testing of the Nyx navigation sensors – Inertial measurement Unit (IMU), GNSS Receiver, Star Tracker and LiDAR – ensuring seamless integration and performance of the Navigation Sensing Suite (NSS) functional chain.Key ResponsibilitiesNavigation Sensor Systems DevelopmentTake technical ownership of the spacecraft's navigation sensor suite, including requirements definition, architecture, component selection, and system-level performance.Define and maintain sensor requirements, specifications, and interfaces in alignment with overall spacecraft mission and system requirements.Assess sensor technologies, evaluate design trade-offs, and drive technical decisions to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and suitability for the mission.Ensure proper integration of navigation sensors into the spacecraft avionics architecture.Supplier and Component ManagementAct as the technical focal point for navigation sensor suppliers throughout the component development lifecycle.Coordinate technical reviews, manage supplier deliverables, and resolve technical issues throughout development and procurement.Testing, Verification and CertificationDevelop and maintain verification and qualification strategies for navigation sensor components and systems.Define and review test plans, procedures, and acceptance criteria.Coordinate and support component-level testing, environmental qualification, functional verification, and system integration testing.Analyze test results, assess compliance with requirements, and drive resolution of identified anomalies.Prepare and maintain verification evidence and technical documentation to support qualification, certification, and mission readiness.Support reviews and technical interactions with customers, external stakeholders, and certification authorities.GNC and Cross-Functional IntegrationWork closely with the GNC team to define navigation sensor performance requirements and ensure alignment with spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control needs.Collaborate on sensor selection, performance modeling, and system-level performance assessments.Support the development and validation of sensor models and their integration into GNC algorithms and simulations.Coordinate with other spacecraft engineering disciplines to ensure consistent interfaces and successful end-to-end system integration.Required QualificationsMaster's or Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.5+ years of experience in avionics, spacecraft systems, navigation sensors, or aerospace systems engineering.Experience developing, integrating, and verifying aerospace sensor systems.Experience working with external suppliers on complex aerospace components.Strong understanding of requirements engineering, system integration, verification, and qualification processes.Experience defining and column1: At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. column1: Central Ops Counterpart: You are the central point of contact and the representative for People Operations in cross-functional projects, most importantly with our People Partners and the Digital Transformation team, and additionally with our Centers of Excellence and other stakeholders such as Finance. column1: client-success-senior-manager-munich-317227,Wellhub,Client Success Senior Manager (m/f/d),"Munich, Bavaria, Germany",False,1795815923,"Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.&nbsp
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!
We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich!

You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.
Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.
Ensure trusting, high-value partnerships with HR contacts, Procurement counterparts, and C-level executives by articulating Wellhub's mission to enhance employee health, engagement, and happiness.
Drive the commercial agenda across your account portfolio, leading annual contract renewals, expansions, and renegotiations to deliver continuous value.
Lead client launches, ongoing strategic relaunch initiatives, and awareness events in close partnership with the Wellhub Wellbeing Engagement Team for end-to-end execution.
Present and implement best-practice workflows, evaluate member growth metrics, suggest targeted adoption strategies, and provide continuous platform updates.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Customer Experience, Operations, User Growth Marketing, Fitness Partnerships, Business Development, and Wellbeing Engagement teams—to build adoption strategies and hit shared goals.
Analyze client data and metrics to deliver actionable findings, shaping tailored communication and awareness campaigns that boost user engagement and defeat inactivity.

Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.
An accomplished relationship leader with 5+ years of experience managing complex client relationships in a client-facing capacity.
A commercial driver with proven expertise leading end-to-end contract negotiations for renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, aligning client growth goals with company revenue targets.
A dynamic and collaborative partner who thrives in team environments, brings creative problem-solving skills, and works seamlessly with cross-functional groups.
An exceptional communicator who provides superior customer service to both internal stakeholders and executive-level external clients.
A detail-oriented project manager with deep experience orchestrating multiple complex client deliverables and priorities concurrently.
An analytical thinker fluent in tracking data, interpreting performance reports, and leveraging insights into concrete operational strategies.
A process innovator capable of refining job protocols, optimizing workflows, and proactively navigating change in a fast-paced global business environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in enterprise client relationship management and commercial contract negotiations are mandatory requirements.

column2: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

column2: build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.&nbsp

column1: AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

column1: intescia-data-scientist-h-f-stage-master-ii-6-mois-carquefou-238178,INTESCIA GROUP,INTESCIA - DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) - Stage MASTER II (6 mois),"CARQUEFOU, Pays de la Loire, France",False,1795858306,"DATA SCIENTIST (H/F)STAGE MASTER II - 6 moisRejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !Qui sommes-nous ?Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.Contexte du stageLes LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ».Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place.Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie.Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe.Votre mission :L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées.Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse.Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus.Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont :• Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore• Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise• Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.&nbsp

column1: productmanager-team-sellers-nijverdal-363279,12Build,Productmanager - Team Sellers,"Nijverdal, Overijssel, Nederland",False,1795804279,"Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.Het team en de uitdagingTeam Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.Hoe we werken12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.Wat ga je doen?Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.Over 12BuildAl bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan?&nbsp

column1: responsable-des-mobilites-entrantes-cdd-24-mois-palaiseau-182751,Institut Mines-Télécom,Responsable des mobilités entrantes - CDD 24 mois,"PALAISEAU, Île-de-France, France",False,1795804277,"Qui sommes-nous ?Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable des mobilités entrantes pour rejoindre la Direction des Relations Internationale (DRI).L’École a développé au fil des années une solide expertise dans l’attractivité et l’accueil des étudiants internationaux. column1: stage-m2-optimisation-de-limplantation-de-loffre-de-soins-en-zones-rurales-albi-204182,Institut Mines-Télécom,Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales,"Albi, Occitanie, France",False,1795804277,"Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones ruralesOrganisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines AlbiLe Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.).Contexte et missionsLes inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale.Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales.Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins.Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI.Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème.Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré.L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet.État de l’artLes problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3]De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5]Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins.Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7].Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires.Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales.Profil recherchéNous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe.Compétences attendues :Formalisation de problèmes complexes (PL, PLNE)Compétences solides en algorithmique et programmation (de préférence Python)Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais pour la documentation et la communication des résultatsModalitésDate de début : à partir de février 2027 (flexible)Durée : 5-6 moisLaboratoire : Centre Génie Industriel, IMT Mines Albi.Lieu : AlbiContactPour toute question concernant le stage, contactez Cléa Martinez ----- candidater, envoyez votre CV, lettre de motivation, et notes de master à Cléa Martinez (Références[1] M. column1: strategy-operations-analyst-paris-176419,Pennylane SAS,Strategy & Operations Analyst,Paris,False,1795794017,"Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our visionWe aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About usPennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Our electronic invoicing track represents a core strategic priority for Pennylane. This dedicated team is responsible for developing our comprehensive electronic invoicing offering for our accounting firm partners and their SME clients (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), accelerating client acquisition, enhancing customer satisfaction, and establishing operational excellence within this segment. As our cross-functional initiatives expand, we now require robust frameworks for end-to-end process management, data-driven performance analytics, and a relentless focus on operational efficiency and scalability. We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy &amp
column2: Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership. Why this role matters at Pennylane The Strategy &amp
column3: Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. column1: head-of-hardware-zurich-56355,Microagi,Head of Hardware,Zürich,False,1795794013,"Accelerating embodied AGI.The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.What You Will DoOwn the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.RequirementsYou have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.Nice to HaveWearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow",['git'],1

column1: signature-coordinator-uk-london-323790,Neko Health,Signature Coordinator - UK,London,False,1795815614,"MissionNeko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. column1: AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role:
As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas
column2: (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

column1: Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France.&nbsp
column2: This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

column1: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.&nbsp
You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.

Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 2+ years of pre-sales experience
Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.
Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, Fleet or general operations background a huge plus
Previous experience working in a Fleet Sales environment
Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.)
Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.

column1: social-media-manager-gastronomie-hospitality-h-f-lyon-30411,CULINARY AGENCY,Social Media Manager – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F),Lyon,False,1795687273,"REJOIGNEZ UNE AGENCE EN PLEINE CROISSANCE ! Vous aimez la gastronomie, les belles maisons, les restaurants, les chefs et l'hôtellerie haut de gamme ?Vous avez le sens de l'image, une vraie sensibilité esthétique et aimez raconter des histoires à travers les réseaux sociaux ?Vous savez qu'un compte Instagram ne se résume pas à publier du contenu : il s'agit de construire un univers, de retranscrire l'identité d'une maison et de créer une véritable expérience de marque.Alors, vous êtes peut-être notre prochain·e Social Media Manager ! Nous accompagnons des restaurants, chefs, hôtels et marques dans le développement de leur image et de leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux. Dans le cadre de notre croissance et du développement de notre portefeuille clients, nous recrutons un·e Social Media Manager en CDI pour renforcer notre équipe. VOS MISSIONSEn lien direct avec les clients, notre directrice stratégique et opérationnelle et nos équipes de création de contenu, vous prenez en main la gestion quotidienne des réseaux sociaux de votre portefeuille. Vous serez responsable d'environ 7 à 8 comptes clients, avec pour objectif de développer leur visibilité, leur engagement et la cohérence de leur image de marque. Vos missions s'articuleront autour de trois grands axes :1. STRATÉGIE ÉDITORIALE & IDENTITÉ DE MARQUEParticiper à la définition des identités visuelles des nouveaux clients sur les réseaux sociaux.Construire des calendriers éditoriaux mensuels adaptés à chaque établissement ou marque.Comprendre et retranscrire les codes, le positionnement et l'univers de chaque client.Imaginer des prises de parole et des storytelling cohérents avec l'identité de chaque maison.2. CRÉATION DE CONTENU & GESTION INSTAGRAMCréer des stories et carrousels visuellement soignés.Monter des stories vidéo et adapter les contenus aux différents formats Instagram.Rédiger des captions engageantes, avec une attention particulière portée au ton et à l'identité de chaque client.Programmer et diffuser les publications aux moments et dans les conditions les plus pertinents.Veiller à la bonne exploitation des contenus produits par nos équipes de création (photos, vidéos et Reels).3. ANIMATION & PERFORMANCEAssurer la modération des comptes : réponses aux commentaires et aux messages privés.Veiller à la cohérence et à la qualité des publications.Suivre les tendances Social Media, Instagram, Food et Hospitality.Identifier les nouveaux formats et les opportunités permettant d'améliorer la visibilité et les performances des comptes.VOTRE RYTHME DE PRODUCTIONVous évoluerez sur un portefeuille de 7 à 8 clients, avec un rythme pouvant aller jusqu'à :4 stories par semaine et par client.1 carrousel par semaine et par client.4 Reels diffusés par semaine et par client. Vous travaillerez en coordination avec nos équipes de création de contenu, qui vous accompagneront dans la production des contenus photo et vidéo. Vous serez accompagné·e à votre arrivée par notre directrice des opérations et une Social Media Manager senior. L'objectif : vous permettre de prendre progressivement vos marques et de gérer votre portefeuille en autonomie. LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONSNous recherchons une personne ayant déjà une première expérience professionnelle en Social Media Management.Une expérience dans la restauration, la gastronomie, l'hôtellerie ou l'Hospitality sera particulièrement appréciée.Deux critères sont indispensables pour ce poste :1. Vous avez déjà géré plusieurs comptes Social Media simultanément.Vous avez une expérience concrète de la gestion de plusieurs comptes clients en parallèle. Vous savez jongler entre différents univers, respecter des calendriers éditoriaux et adapter votre communication à chaque marque.Une première expérience en agence ou dans un environnement multi-clients est particulièrement pertinente.2. Vous avez un véritable intérêt pour la gastronomie et les univers haut de gamme.Restaurants, chefs, belles maisons, hôtels, expériences gastronomiques… Ces univers vous attirent sincèrement.Vous n'avez pas nécessairement besoin d'y avoir travaillé, mais vous devez avoir envie de les découvrir, d'en comprendre les codes et de savoir les mettre en valeur. Au-delà de ces deux indispensables, vous êtes une personne qui :Possède un véritable œil esthétique et une forte sensibilité à l'image.Maîtrise les codes d'Instagram et des formats courts.Aime créer des contenus visuels et monter des vidéos.Possède de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et une orthographe irréprochable.Est curieuse, créative et attentive aux tendances Social Media.Fait preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et d'une grande attention aux détails.Sait gérer plusieurs projets et priorités en simultané.Est autonome, réactive et apprécie le travail en équipe.A envie d'apprendre, de progresser et de s'investir dans une agence ambitieuse.CE QUE NOUS VOUS PROPOSONS Une rémunération adaptée à votre expérience :Profil junior : 27 000 à 28 000 € brut annuel fixe complété par une rémunération variable pouvant atteindre 1 000 € brut annuel.Profil expérimenté : rémunération pouvant atteindre 35 000 € brut annuel fixe selon l'expérience et le niveau d'autonomie. VOS AVANTAGESTélétravail : prime mensuelle de 50 € brut.Transports : prise en charge de 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun, y compris en télétravail.Noël : bons cadeaux offerts.Croissance de l'agence : mise en place en cours d'une prime complémentaire liée au développement de Culinary Agency.Matériel professionnel : iPhone et ordinateur fournis. ORGANISATION DU TRAVAILLocalisation : LyonNous fonctionnons actuellement sans bureaux fixes. Nous privilégions le télétravail et les sessions de travail en cafés avec le reste de l'équipe, organisées régulièrement. Des bureaux sont envisagés dans les prochains mois.Horaires habituels : 9h30 – 18h30, avec une certaine flexibilité selon les besoins des clients.Organisation libre entre télétravail et sessions de travail avec l'équipe. Déplacements :Environ un déplacement par trimestre en Île-de-France.Quelques déplacements ponctuels en région selon les besoins des clients. NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENTNous souhaitons prendre le temps de rencontrer les candidats et d'évaluer concrètement leur sensibilité créative, leur compréhension des réseaux sociaux et leur capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes clients.Notre processus se déroule en quatre étapes :1. Entretien de préqualification en visioconférenceUn premier échange pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours et vous présenter Culinary Agency.2. Étude de cas / mise en situationSi le premier échange est concluant, nous vous proposons un exercice pratique pour mieux comprendre votre approche créative et votre manière de travailler.3. Prise de références professionnellesNous souhaitons échanger avec des personnes ayant déjà travaillé avec vous.4. Entretien final avec le CEO fondateurUn dernier échange pour approfondir votre candidature et vous permettre de découvrir la vision et les ambitions de l'agence. POURQUOI REJOINDRE CULINARY AGENCY ?Rejoindre Culinary Agency, c'est intégrer une agence en pleine croissance, spécialisée dans des univers passionnants, où l'image, la créativité et le sens du détail occupent une place centrale.Vous travaillerez sur des projets variés, auprès de restaurants, chefs, hôtels et marques, avec la possibilité de développer votre expertise en Social Media Management dans l'univers de la gastronomie et de l'Hospitality.Vous aimez les beaux contenus, les belles histoires et les univers qui ont une véritable identité ?Vous avez envie de rejoindre une équipe ambitieuse et de participer activement au développement d'une agence en pleine expansion ?Nous serions ravis de découvrir votre profil !Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow",['git'],1

product-frontend-engineer-zurich-295369,"ServiceHunter AG - quitt, quinn",Product Frontend Engineer,Zürich,False,1795530645,"quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.
Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.
The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.
The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.

The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.
You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.
You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow",['scala'],1

chief-financial-officer-zurich-136620,"ServiceHunter AG - quitt, quinn",Chief Financial Officer,Zürich,False,1795440652,"Most CFOs inherit a finance function.
This one gets to build it.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.
Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result.
The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round.
We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone.
Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time.
Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage.
The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded.
A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise.

You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision.
There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly.

Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design.

You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream.
You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers.

By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months.

You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it.
You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business.

You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter.

Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once.

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action
The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally!
Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered.Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow",[],0

De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen.
Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn.

Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft.
AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat.
Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei.
Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope.

Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van.

Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten.

Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Dat vraagt dat je kunt uitleggen waarom iets niet deugt zonder dat iemand zich aangevallen voelt, en dat je ze in gewone taal meeneemt in hoe het wel hoort.

column2: English · Full-timeCompetitive salary · Early equityYOUR MISSIONA software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor.
