head-of-investor-relations-platform-community-berlin-220569,P3A,"Head of Investor Relations, Platform & Community (m/w/d)",Berlin,False,1795683673,"P3A is a multi-platform operating and investment group building the infrastructure of tomorrow. Entrepreneurial at its core, P3A builds, owns, and backs the companies behind the assets the modern world depends on, bringing long-term capital and deep operational expertise to how critical infrastructure is built, operated, and financed. P3A was founded by serial entrepreneur Jannes Fischer in 2023.

As Head of Investor Relations, Platform & Community (m/w/d), you will build and own the platform that connects P3A with the world around it: investors, entrepreneurs, and portfolio founders. Your mission is to develop our network into a leading community of people who share one ambition, building the infrastructure of tomorrow in Europe.

You will identify and win outstanding investors and personalities for the P3A platform, connect investors, founders, and portfolio companies to unlock synergies across the ecosystem, and shape how P3A is perceived publicly. Our thesis for building this community: a curated event series and circle, in-person formats where the right people meet, designed to carry their own economics. Proving this thesis and shaping the series into an institution will be at the heart of your role.This is an entrepreneurial role with exceptional freedom and full ownership. It is built for a natural connector who moves with ease among accomplished entrepreneurs, investors, and family offices, brings real creativity to formats and experiences, and executes hands-on without a team behind them.
Investor Acquisition: Identify, approach, and win entrepreneurs, family offices, and private investors for the P3A platform, from the first conversation to a lasting relationship
Relationship Ownership: Build trusted relationships at eye level, in substantive conversations on venture capital, private markets, and the current market environment
Network Orchestration: Connect investors, founders, and portfolio companies with one another, identify synergies, and turn introductions into tangible value for everyone involved
Community Management: Run the day-to-day of the P3A community across all channels, from our annual Portfolio Day to the ongoing exchange within our founder and investor network
Event Series & Formats: Design, build, and run P3A's event series end-to-end, from guest curation and programming to venue, execution, and follow-up. This is the engine of the community
Partnerships & Economics: Win and cultivate the partners who stand behind our event series, and run it with commercial ambition so that it carries and funds its own growth
Experience Quality: Set the highest bar for every touchpoint and create experiences that make remarkable people return and bring their peers
Public Presence: Shape and sharpen P3A's public profile, including the executive positioning and communications of our leadership
Storytelling: Translate events, milestones, and portfolio successes into compelling communication across our channels
Thought Leadership: Develop content and formats that position P3A at the center of the European conversation on the infrastructure of tomorrow

Natural Connector: You burn for bringing people together. People genuinely enjoy your company: a charismatic host and sharp conversationalist, at eye level with accomplished entrepreneurs and investors
Creative Builder: You develop original formats and ideas rather than copying playbooks, and you execute them hands-on, down to the last detail
Winner Mentality: We are a small team in which every single person performs at the highest level. You seek that intensity, put in the hours it takes, and play to win
Discretion & Judgment: You move in confidential settings with tact and understand that trust is the foundation of everything we do

Relevant Background: You bring at least 3 years of experience with sophisticated private clients or investors, for example in investor relations, private banking or wealth management, membership organizations, or a comparable relationship-driven environment
Investment Fluency: You are fully conversant in venture capital, private markets, and investing, and you follow markets and technology closely enough to hold your own with professional investors
Education & Presence: You combine an excellent education with intellectual range and the personal presence to represent P3A in any room
Communication Craft: You write exceptionally well in both long and short form. Experience in executive communications or brand building is a strong plus
Communication Skills: Confident engaging with founders, investors, and senior stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication in both German and English is mandatory
Location Availability: You are able to commit to working with the P3A team on-site in our Berlin headquarters
Entrepreneurial Freedom: Build the platform from scratch and own it end-to-end, with exceptional creative freedom, direct access to decision-making, and responsibility from day one
Performance Upside: A solid base salary plus a performance bonus tied directly to the growth of the platform: the investors you win and the partnerships you build for the platform
Meaningful Impact: Your work directly advances how the critical infrastructure Europe depends on is financed and built
Exceptional People: Work daily with remarkable entrepreneurs, investors, and operators, and develop at the intersection of capital, community, and company building
Room to Build: Our event series is at pilot stage. You will shape it into an institution and define its formats, rituals, and standards from the ground up
Established Platform: Leverage direct access to P3A's capital, portfolio, and domain expertise to create rooms and experiences that cannot be bought
Network Access: Build lasting personal relationships with the entrepreneurs, family offices, and investors shaping the next generation of infrastructure technology companies

edge-machine-integration-engineer-plc-to-cloud-freelance-ruti-247029,Falu AG,"Edge & Machine Integration Engineer (PLC to Cloud), Freelance, m/f/d",Rüti,False,1795274246,"FALU AG in Rüti (ZH) builds and sells swab production machines that run in plants around the world. The cloud side of PMAS is built and running in production: broker, ingestion service, databases, web app. The path from the PLC inside the machine to the MQTT broker is covered by one engineer who designed and built it. With more machines and more plants coming, that one person is no longer enough. We are looking for a freelancer who adds capacity on exactly this path: PLC software, Raspberry Pi edge devices, site gateway, broker connection.

This is a permanent role that we staff on a freelance basis: no project end date, a long term engagement with about 1 week of work per month, with more when a rollout is on. You will work directly with our existing integration engineer, our inhouse engineering team and the CEO.

You work on everything between the machine PLC and the MQTT broker, alongside the engineer who built the current setup. Which parts you take over completely and which you share depends on your strengths. Concretely:

Bring the PMAS message format into the CB1 machine software (Siemens S7, TIA Portal V18 with HMI) and keep it in sync with the payload contract: cumulative counters, machine status, error codes, timestamps from the PLC clock.

Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.
Manage PLC software versions across the fleet, including safe update and rollback procedures for machines already running at customers.
Ensure clock discipline on the PLCs (NTP, local time zone per plant), since every duration KPI is computed from PLC timestamps.

Develop and maintain the software on the Raspberry Pi based edge devices next to each machine: MQTT client, buffering and store and forward during uplink outages, unique client IDs, credential handling, health reporting.
Develop and maintain the site gateway: isolated machine network, routing and firewall, outbound only TLS and NTP, remote maintenance access, watchdogs, recovery from a spare device.

Help turn the current setup into a provisioning process: golden image, per machine configuration, fleet wide updates without a site visit. A new machine goes from unboxing to ""visible in the dashboard"" in under an hour.
Monitor the edge layer so that we know about a degraded device before the customer does.
Administer the HiveMQ Cloud clusters per customer: credentials, topic ACLs, client ID scheme, certificates.
Maintain the payload contract together with the existing integration engineer. Changes are versioned and documented.
Onboard new customers and new machines end to end, remotely where possible and on site where needed (primarily Europe and the United States).
Act as second line when ""the dashboard shows nothing"" or ""the numbers look wrong"" and the cause sits between PLC and broker.
Write the documentation you would have wanted on day one: onboarding sheets, runbooks, wiring notes.
Siemens PLC programming in TIA Portal (SCL and LAD, S7-1200/1500 family). You can open an existing machine project, understand it and change it without breaking the machine.
Industrial networking: PROFINET, VLANs, static and DHCP setups, firewalls, TLS basics. You have connected a machine to a network that was not built for it.
Linux on Raspberry Pi or comparable single board computers: systemd, networking, images, headless operation, remote administration.
Solid programming skills in Python or Node.js for edge software, and Git as a daily tool.
MQTT in depth: versions 3.1.1 and 5.0, QoS levels, retained messages, last will, TLS, broker ACLs.

Machines you can touch: a test bench at FALU in Rüti with real PLCs and edge hardware.
Remote by default, on site in Rüti when hardware is involved. Travel to customer plants is paid on top of the rate.
A permanent role, not a project with an end date: growing volume as more plants go live, on a freelance basis for as long as it works for both sides.

Eine Standortleitung braucht bis Mitte des Monats eine neue Dozentin, also geht die Anzeige heute noch raus. Daneben wartet ein Arbeitsvertrag auf die Unterschrift, zwei Krankmeldungen müssen ins System, die Lohndaten gehen diese Woche an die Steuerberatung, und ein Kollege braucht bis morgen eine Bescheinigung. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.Worum es gehtWir wachsen – mit mehreren Gesellschaften, mehreren Standorten und einem Team, das größer wird. Wenn du gern selbst anpackst, statt Zuständigkeiten zu verteilen, bist du hier richtig.Was du bewegstPersonalabteilung über Personio führen – Du führst unsere Personalarbeit in Personio: Stammdaten, digitale Personalakte, Abwesenheiten, Dokumente, Workflows und Auswertungen. Was noch nicht sauber läuft, richtest du ein.Personalsachbearbeitung von A bis Z – Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen, Zeugnisse und Schreiben erstellst du selbst. Du pflegst die Personalakten und behältst Fristen wie Probezeiten und Befristungen im Blick.Kurzfristig einstellen – Du schreibst Stellen aus, sichtest Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche, stimmst Termine ab und bringst Einstellungen bis zur Vertragsunterschrift – auch wenn es schnell gehen muss.On- und Offboarding – Du begleitest Eintritte und Austritte vollständig: Unterlagen, Unterweisungen, Zugänge, Übergaben.Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung – Du bereitest die monatlichen Lohndaten vor, klärst Rückfragen und hältst den Kontakt zur Steuerberatung.Ansprechperson im Alltag – Du bist erste Adresse für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei allen Personalfragen und bereitest arbeitsrechtliche Vorgänge wie Abmahnungen oder Kündigungen sauber vor.Mitdenken und anpacken – Du kümmerst dich um das, was anfällt – auch wenn es nicht in der Stellenbeschreibung steht.Was du mitbringstQualifikation – Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zur Personalkauffrau bzw. zum Personalkaufmann, ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis.Erfahrung – Mehrjährige Praxis in der operativen Personalarbeit. Du beherrschst das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung und hast es selbst gemacht, nicht nur begleitet.Personio – Du arbeitest sicher mit Personio und hast das System idealerweise selbst eingerichtet oder administriert.Arbeitsrecht – Solide Grundkenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht für das Tagesgeschäft – und das Gespür dafür, wann du dir Rat holst.Hands-on-Mentalität – Du packst an, kümmerst dich und arbeitest gern selbstständig. Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own

Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths

Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
Fluent French and access to our Paris office
Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone.Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. Ceci déstabilise le confort intérieur, qui doit respecter des plages de température et d’humidité pour éviter par exemple les effets de dilatation ou rétractation des matériaux ou assurer l’adhérence des mastics. Un bâtiment de cette envergure, intégrant une ligne mobile, possède alors peu de cloisons, une hauteur sous plafond élevée, et la dalle de sol doit être renforcée et plane pour assurer le déplacement de la ligne mobile, tout en accueillant les alimentations électriques (câbles électriques ou batteries). Ces contraintes structurales impactent directement la localisation des unités de chauffage et de climatisation et la régulation de l’humidité. Dans ce contexte particulier d’une FAL, la conception du bâtiment est un problème complexe nécessitant d’optimiser simultanément plusieurs paramètres :Les dimensions du bâtiment et le positionnement des cloisons internes et unités de chauffage et climatisation devront être optimisés dans le respect des contraintes techniques d’assemblage et de régulation de la température et de l’humidité. Dans un second temps, la zone bureau sera intégrée, avec un objectif de confort intérieur différent.L’introduction de sas (dimensions à étudier) vise directement à constituer un effet tampon pour faciliter la régulation du confort intérieur (température, humidité) lors des séquences d’ouverture et fermeture des portails. La disposition des sas dépend aussi de la localisation des éléments de chauffage et de climatisation.La consommation énergétique est liée au chauffage, à la climatisation mais aussi à l’éclairage.En effet, les opérations d’assemblage nécessitent une luminosité constante sur les différents postes d’assemblage, parfois à des hauteurs différentes. La consommation énergétique liée au confort intérieur (température, humidité) est particulièrement complexe à optimiser et à homogénéiser dans le bâtiment en raison de son envergure et du faible nombre de cloisons disponibles. Une étude d’intégration d’énergies renouvelables est prévue sur les aspects chaleur et électricité, notamment en prenant en compte l’alimentation électrique directe ou indirecte par batteries de la ligne mobile.L’impact énergétique, environnemental et la résilience du bâtiment en fonction de son implantation et de l’évolution des conditions climatiques sera étudié. Les simulations seront alors réalisées pour des localisations correspondant à des conditions météorologiques de plus en plus sévères afin de tester la résilience.Ces verrous scientifiques et techniques associés directement à la typologie du bâtiment FAL et des matériaux sélectionnés seront supportés par la simulation thermique dynamique (STD) des scénarios d’usage étudiés, par l’analyse de cycle de vie (ACV) du bâtiment et par des analyses d’impacts.Mots-clésBâtiment industriel de grande envergure, indicateurs de performance énergétique et environnementale, confort intérieur, résilience, bâtiment écoresponsable, simulation thermique dynamique (STD)Compétences :Il est attendu que le/la candidat(e) soit titulaire d’un bac+5 en génie énergétique ou ingénierie de la performance.Le/la candidat(e) devra posséder de solides connaissances associées au génie climatique et énergétique (en particulier les solutions d’énergies renouvelables et les systèmes CVC) et au management de la performance (notamment les indicateurs de performance industrielle et les indicateurs énergétiques et environnementaux). column1: acquisition-operations-paris-244008,Zefir,Acquisition Operations,Paris,False,1795610428,"Who We AreZefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.The missionZefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet. What you'll buildHorizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days)Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it.Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call.Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly.Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9)Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks.Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing.Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters.Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond)Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel.Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously.Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it. Why this roleImpact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days.Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. regional-sales-director-core-enterprise-dach-berlin-77723,Samsara,"Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH","Berlin, Germany",False,1795643126,"Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.
This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.
Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win

Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets
Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
Fluent German and based in Germany
Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.
Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.
Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.

growth-berlin-256109,Augustus,Growth,Berlin,False,1795642821,"Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.The RoleYou generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE.You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show.Your First Six MonthsMonths 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate. Go to your first conference with the team: help with pre-booking, work the floor alongside our Sales and Growth teams, and book your first meetings. By the end of month two, you can pitch Augustus on your own.Months 3-4: Execution is yours. Own a conference end to end, from the target list to the follow-up: book the meetings, route each one to the right AE and make sure it happens. Take meetings on your own and work closely with Sales and Marketing.Months 5-6: Own the pipeline for a set of markets and run your first event. You've turned what you've learned into data: which conferences, intros and markets bring deals that close, and which don't. You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with.Who Will Thrive At AugustusWe believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.This role is for you if:You're outgoing and at your best in front of people. You can start a conversation with a stranger at a booth and hold it with a bank's CFO.You do what needs to be done, even when it's not glamorous: building a prospecting list, chasing a follow-up, carrying boxes to the booth.You think clearly and work from data. You take an unstructured dataset and come back with answers and insights.You're diligent and organised. Nothing falls through the cracks.You use AI to move fast, but don't trust the output blindly. You check results, question the systems and don't ship anything you wouldn't put your name on.You're curious: when something takes too long, you find a faster way to do it.After every conference, you know what you'd do differently next time, and you do it.This is not for you if:You'd rather work behind a screen than in front of people. Most of our pipeline starts with a conversation in person.You want a well-defined scope and clear processes. Ours change as we grow, and you'll help build many of them.You want a predictable week. lead-customer-success-paris-345091,Parallel,Lead Customer Success,Paris,False,1795578194,"At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.
Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.
Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.&nbsp
column2: Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.&nbsp

column1: This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.
This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.&nbsp

You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.&nbsp
You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.
Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.
MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien.
Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet.

Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft.

End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams.

Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme.

Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug

column3: As a Senior 3D Reconstruction and Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate.&amp

column5: How your work moves the mission forward&lt

column3: Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models&lt

Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)&lt

Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties&lt

Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)&lt
Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories&lt
Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)&lt
Collaborate with Engineering teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware&lt
Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data&amp

column1: Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.
Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.
Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.
Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.
Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.
Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.
L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :
Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,

Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.

Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).
Les à-côtés du poste 👁️Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&amp
column2: D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.Les missions pourront comprendre :•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.•L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal.Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet.  Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées.Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées.Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon)

column1: Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ?

Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu.
Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing.
• Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes.
• Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données.

• Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing.
• Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.
• Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier).
• Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour.
• Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit.
• Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture.
• Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation.
• Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution.
• Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités.
• Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états.
• Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires.

Safety PLC applications, such as Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE, or SICK Flexi Soft.
Low-level, hardware-related software development, including CAN drivers, PROFINET, timing, and synchronization in sensor networks, ideally combined with microcontroller or embedded systems knowledge.
Autonomous software for real robots, such as localization, navigation, and motion planning, combined with an interest in developing deeper expertise in low-level control.

You are passionate about developing software that enables heavy autonomous vehicles to move smoothly and safely, and want to help shape the future of large robotic fleets in real warehouse environments.

column1: senior-embedded-android-engineer-hardware-berlin-34299,SumUp,Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware,"Berlin, Germany",False,1795470325,"Team description

SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.
Please note this role would require relocation to Berlin, Germany.
Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework
Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components
Contribute to build system integration across the platform
Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing
Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release
You'll be great for this role if…
Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage
Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments

Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.
You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.&nbsp

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.
Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.
You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.&nbsp

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

column11: Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers.&nbsp
column12: Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments.&nbsp

column19: Hands-on experience with Kalman filters, nonlinear estimation or probabilistic filtering.&nbsp
column20: A proven track record of designing, tuning and validating controllers for highly dynamic systems.&nbsp
column21: Strong implementation skills in Rust, C++ or another systems programming language.&nbsp
